fixes_summary: H1 FIXED: setMatches(data) → setMatches(data.matches) in handleApplyFilters, handleClearFilters, handleBulkAction (MatchesClient.tsx lines ~94, ~112, ~149)
H2 FIXED: bulk PATCH body { ids, action } → { ids, status: action } (MatchesClient.tsx line ~137)
M1 FIXED: params.set('cargo_type', cargoTypes.join(',')) → for loop with params.append('cargo_type', ct) (MatchesClient.tsx line ~80)
M2 FIXED: added isNaN guard for dwtMin and dwtMax in GET /api/matches (route.ts lines ~64-66)
M3 FIXED: added isNaN guard for laycanFromMs and laycanToMs in GET /api/matches (route.ts lines ~57-58)
post_fix_test_result: 128/128 M3 tests green (matches-bulk + matches-filters + matches-repository-filters + matches-client-m3)

low.title: Migration is not idempotent; re-run would throw SQLite 'duplicate column name' error
low.detail: SQLite ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN does not support IF NOT EXISTS. The migration runner itself tracks applied versions via schema version table, so this is only a risk if migration 033 up() is called directly (not through the runner). Acceptable LOW risk.

low.title: Feature flag checked before session auth in PATCH bulk — minor pattern inconsistency
low.detail: PATCH bulk checks isFeatureEnabled() before requireSession(). Other handlers check auth first. Not a security issue (503 before 401 leaks no info) but inconsistent. Not fixed to minimize PI3 risk (no test covers this ordering).

info.title: LOWER() wrapping for route LIKE filter is correct and injection-safe
info.detail: Route filter uses LOWER(load_port) LIKE LOWER(?) with ? placeholder. Safe from SQL injection. Correctly handles ASCII case-insensitivity.

info.title: Static-analysis tests cannot catch runtime data-shape bugs (design limitation noted)
info.detail: The 60 UI tests (matches-client-m3.test.tsx) use fs.readFileSync + regex. They confirmed API call patterns but could not detect the setMatches(data) vs setMatches(data.matches) mismatch (H1) or the { action } vs { status } body key mismatch (H2). These are runtime behavioral bugs that required human/QI review to catch. This is a known trade-off of the static-analysis test strategy used by this project.

boundary_check_notes.class_1_empty: Empty ids → 400. Empty cargo_type array skips IN filter. Filter panel renders with empty matches list.
boundary_check_notes.class_2_nan: PASS (post-fix) — dwtMin/dwtMax and laycan timestamps now guarded with isNaN checks matching the limit/offset pattern.
boundary_check_notes.class_3_negative: Math.max(0, score_min) in repository clamps negatives to 0.
boundary_check_notes.class_6_substring: Array.includes() for status validation — exact match. 'save' does not match 'saved'.
boundary_check_notes.class_9_e2e: PASS (post-fix) — filter flow now correctly uses data.matches, cargo_type uses multi-value params, laycan overlap semantics correct.

security_check_notes.feature_flag: MATCHES_ENABLED checked in all 4 handlers (GET, POST, PATCH bulk, DELETE bulk). Returns 503 when disabled.
security_check_notes.session_auth: requireSession() in all 4 handlers. Returns 401 on missing/expired session.
security_check_notes.admin_auth: requireAdmin() in DELETE bulk only. Returns 500 if ADMIN_TOKEN unconfigured, 401 if header missing/wrong.
security_check_notes.sql_injection: All params use ? placeholders. No string interpolation of user values into SQL. Sort allowlist prevents injection via sort_by/sort_dir.
security_check_notes.input_validation: PASS (post-fix) — NaN guards added for dwtMin/dwtMax and laycan timestamps.

pi3_compliance.notes: phase_2b verdicts confirm test_rewrite_count=0 for both backend and UI. Fixes applied in Phase 3 are production-code-only changes; no test expectations were modified.

laycan_semantics_check.detail: laycan_end >= laycan_from AND laycan_start <= laycan_to — correct range-overlap semantics (not containment).

verdict_reason: All HIGH and MEDIUM findings fixed. 2 LOW findings remain (non-blocking). 128/128 M3 tests pass post-fix.
